verdict.rationale: Community Phone's business Team plan lists a "Dial menu" alongside a shared team number, live transfer, and "Advanced call routing", and the business page says admins can "set up call routing" and route every call to the right person. That is the product's own documented capability, but only as plan-feature bullets with no detail on how menus are built or mapped to teams. Missing for 10: documentation of configuring menu options (press 1 for sales), evidence that menu choices route to team groups or ring groups, menu-building UI or setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
